notes: S1-FIX3 V2/§12.2 check 1: the receipt bytes are truncated, so the whole file is not one complete DER TimeStampResp. The attestation timestamp digest is recomputed over the mutated bytes, so the mutation reaches DER parsing instead of stopping at E_TS_FILE. Check 1 runs before the CMS checks: the receipt is rejected with E_TS_SCHEMA at the timestamp phase (step 11), after the records were processed. An invalid receipt is not present-unverified, so L_TSA_TRUST_UNVERIFIED is not reported; the exact limitations list is [L_CHAIN_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED, L_OFFLINE_CONTEXT].
